regions.tonight: Tonight will remain mostly dry with clear spells. Noticeably colder tonight with lowest temperatures of -1 to +3 degrees and some ground frosts, with light to moderate northerly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Thursday, will be predominately dry and sunny. Highest temperatures of 6 to 10 degrees in light to moderate northerly breezes, fresher along the coast and easing later in the afternoon.
